rules.response: Press X on the model list to open 360 Assistant. It works with no GGUF files. Press A to enter text, then type help. B returns to models. Notes and your name save in 360AI-assistant.json; timers are session-only.

Copy assistant-rules.example.json to assistant-rules.json beside 360AI.xex, edit it and restart. Each rule has phrases and a text response. Use up to 64 rules, 8 phrases per rule and 2000 bytes per response. These rules supply answers only; they cannot execute commands. Updates ship the example and preserve your custom file.
For a local reminder, type remember to clean the controller. For a timed alert, type remind me in 10 minutes to clean the controller. Keep 360AI open for timer alerts.
